# HIcon

> A small, consistent supporting icon set. Decorative by default; put the accessible label on its control.

[Start with the Hearth UI agent index](../../../llms.txt). This reference describes repository source; package.json version: 0.2.0. Match it to the source/release you are using.

## Identity

- Vue export: `HIcon` from `@samishal1998/hearth-ui`.
- Custom element: `<hearth-icon>`.
- Individual constructor: `HearthIconElement` from `@samishal1998/hearth-ui/elements`.
- Category: Foundation.
- [Implementation](https://github.com/samishal1998/hearth-ui/blob/main/src/components/HIcon.vue).

## Choose and use it correctly

- Icons are decorative and aria-hidden. Name the containing button or link; an icon is not an accessible control on its own.
- Use a supported icon name. Unknown names fall back to apps.

## Public API

name: string · size: number = 20

A `?` marks optional source props. A prop with a default may be omitted even when the source type is required. Internal `formDisabled` and `control-sync` plumbing is excluded below; do not use it in application code.

```ts
type Props = {
    name?: string;
    size?: number;
};
```

### Defaults

```ts
{
  name: "apps",
  size: 20,
}
```

### Events

None

Vue-emitted custom-element events expose arguments as `event.detail`, an array. Listen directly on the element. Native DOM events such as `click` keep their normal payloads.

### Slots

None

Vue uses `<template #slotName>`; custom elements use `<div slot="slotName">`. Custom elements do not support Vue scoped slots.

### CSS parts

icon

Use `hearth-icon::part(part-name)` for an exposed part, or inherited `--h-*` tokens for system-level styling. Native Vue components use the shared stylesheet and `h-*` classes.

## Vue example

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { HIcon } from '@samishal1998/hearth-ui';
import '@samishal1998/hearth-ui/styles.css';

</script>

<template>
  <HIcon name="server" :size="20" />
</template>
```

## Web-component example

Provide a mount point (use a `form` instead of `div` when demonstrating field submission):

```html
<div id="example"></div>
```

The following is bundler-based ESM. For raw HTML, load `dist/themes.css` with a stylesheet link and import `registerElements` from `./dist/elements/index.js` instead. Set array/object properties before connection when they should become reset defaults.

```js
import { registerElements } from '@samishal1998/hearth-ui/elements';
import '@samishal1998/hearth-ui/themes.css';
registerElements();

const mount = document.querySelector('#example');
const element = document.createElement('hearth-icon');
Object.assign(element, {
  "name": "server",
  "size": 20
});
mount.append(element);
```

## Available icon names

`apps`, `home`, `search`, `plus`, `close`, `arrow`, `launch`, `check`, `star`, `lock`, `globe`, `server`, `providers`, `health`, `settings`, `menu`, `logout`, `moon`, `sun`, `down`, `up`, `info`, `layout`, `code`, `copy`.

## Related components

- [HButton](../button/llms.txt): Native button or link behavior, clear focus, icon-only labels, and restrained press feedback.
- [HBrand](../brand/llms.txt): A text wordmark with the signature accent. Use your own name, optional logo, and tagline.
